message.content:
The first six primes are:

\[
2,3,5,7,11,13
\]

The sum is even if both chosen numbers have the same parity: both even or both odd.

- Even primes in the set: only \(2\), so probability both choose even is  
  \[
  \frac{1}{6}\cdot \frac{1}{6}=\frac{1}{36}
  \]

- Odd primes in the set: \(3,5,7,11,13\), so probability both choose odd is  
  \[
  \frac{5}{6}\cdot \frac{5}{6}=\frac{25}{36}
  \]

Thus the probability the sum is even is

\[
\frac{1}{36}+\frac{25}{36}=\frac{26}{36}=\frac{13}{18}
\]

The answer is \(\frac{13}{18}\).
